LESSON: SIGNIFICANCE OF ISLAMIC MORALITY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Values)
Topic 5.2: Significance of Islamic Morality
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Significance of Islamic Morality, part of Akhlaq (Moral Values) in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to uphold Islamic morality?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research online/from available reference materials on the significance of Islamic morality and make notes,

2. dramatise acts depicting Islamic morality and deduce lessons. learners with blindness can be given physical support as they dramatise.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research online/from available reference materials on the significance of Islamic morality and make notes,
2. dramatise acts depicting Islamic morality and deduce lessons. learners with blindness can be given physical support as they dramatise.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Significance of Islamic Morality together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Respect: enhanced as learners dramatise acts depicting Islamic morality and deduce lessons.

● Unity: as learners dramatise acts depicting Islamic morality.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Social cohesion is enhanced as learners dramatise acts on Islamic morality.

Link to other subjects:

● Social Studies enhanced as learners use digital devices to research on the significance of morality.
